name: @polymarket-bot/pnl
description: PnL engine (WP-200, handoff §9.16): per-owner, per-denomination profit-and-loss projections with realized and unrealized strictly separated, reward estimates never booked as realized, and fee/reward schedule version references carried where available. Pure layer-1 logic: no I/O, no clock, no randomness. Consumes ledger-derived records structurally (no same-layer package edge).
